Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Wenis Ulenun: 24-year-old man, 166 cm (medium), clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: heart-shaped face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; broad low bridge, full lips; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: one longer face-framing section. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette ochre-cream. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
